devdoc.details: Deployed as a transparent proxy. The deployer becomes `owner()` via `__Ownable_init`.      `factory` is set in a post-deploy step by the deployment script so that both      contracts can reference each other after they exist.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

blockWallet(address).details: Does not affect withdrawals. Intended to freeze a compromised or non-compliant wallet.

params.wallet: Address of the SmartWallet proxy to block.

constructor.details: Disables initializers on the implementation contract so it cannot be initialized      directly. Initialization must happen atomically through the proxy's constructor.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setFactory(address).details: Called once by the deployment script immediately after the factory is deployed.

params._relayer: Address of the trusted relayer wallet.

params._stakingContract: Address that receives staked platform tokens.

params.token_: Address of the platform ERC-20 token.

params._vestingContract: Address of the platform vesting contract.

setWithdrawalDelay(uint256).details: Does not affect recipients already past their delay. Existing immediate-flag      entries (init-time addresses) are never affected regardless of this value.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.wallet: Address of the SmartWallet proxy to unblock.

allowedTokens.details: Tokens permitted for use in wallet transfer and withdrawal operations.

blocked.details: Set of wallet addresses blocked from calling `transferAssets` to the strategy.

factory.details: Set by the deployment script after the factory is deployed, and updatable by the      owner via `setFactory`. Kept as an on-chain reference to the current factory.

relayer.details: Prevents front-running of counterfactual wallet addresses: wallet addresses depend      only on (factory, walletId), so deployment must be restricted to a trusted relayer.

strategyAddress.details: Typically a yield strategy or protocol vault. Wallets read this on each transfer      so a single update here reroutes the entire fleet.

withdrawalDelay.details: Defaults to 24 hours. Gives owners a window to revoke a mistaken whitelist entry      before funds can flow out.

devdoc.title: SmartWalletCoordinator

allowToken(address).notice: Adds a token to the allowlist, enabling it for transfers and withdrawals.

blockWallet(address).notice: Blocks a wallet from routing funds to the strategy via `transferAssets`.

disallowToken(address).notice: Removes a token from the allowlist.

getAllowedTokens().notice: Returns all tokens currently on the allowlist.

getBlockedWallets().notice: Returns all wallets currently blocked from sending to the strategy.

isBlocked(address).notice: Returns whether a wallet is blocked from sending to the strategy.

isTokenAllowed(address).notice: Returns whether a token is on the allowlist for asset movements.

relayer().notice: The only address permitted to deploy wallets through the SmartWalletFactory.

setRelayer(address).notice: Sets the relayer allowed to deploy wallets through the factory.

setStakingContract(address).notice: Sets the staking contract address for platform transfers.

setStakingToken(address).notice: Sets the platform token address for staking.

setStrategyAddress(address).notice: Updates the strategy address that all wallet transfers are routed to.

setVestingContract(address).notice: Sets the vesting contract address for platform vesting operations.

setWithdrawalDelay(uint256).notice: Updates the withdrawal delay applied to newly whitelisted recipients.

stakingContract().notice: Staking contract address — routing target for wallet staking calls and the         only caller trusted by `VestingDistributor.claimFor`.

stakingToken().notice: The platform token. Only this token may be staked via SmartWallet.stake.

strategyAddress().notice: Contract for all `transferAssets` calls across every SmartWallet.

unblockWallet(address).notice: Removes a block previously set on a wallet.

vestingContract().notice: Vesting contract address — resolved by `Staking` for claims and balance reads.

withdrawalDelay().notice: Minimum time (in seconds) that must pass after a recipient is added to a         wallet's whitelist before that recipient can receive withdrawals.

userdoc.notice: Central authority for the Palantex smart wallet system. Holds system-wide         configuration (strategy address, withdrawal delay) and exposes `owner()` as         the single admin identity — the factory delegates its admin checks here.
